pattern: SELECT .+ FROM Dogs WHERE dog_id IN \(\s*(SELECT dog_id FROM Treatments(?: JOIN Charges ON Treatments\.cost_of_treatment = Charges\.charge_amount)? GROUP BY dog_id HAVING SUM\(Charges\.charge_amount\)\s*[<=]\s*1000\s*\)
correction: Replace the subquery with a query that selects dog_ids that have received treatments costing more than $1000 in total, and use NOT IN instead of IN

metadata.description: This rule corrects a SQL query that incorrectly filters treatments based on their charge amount, potentially excluding dogs that meet the condition of having spent over $1000 on treatments in total.
